User Story: As a developer I want one command to start the data plane so that anyone can run Prognos locally
As a platform engineer I want telemetry to survive a broker failure so that no events are lost
As a fleet manager I want my fleet data isolated from other customers so that it is never exposed or corrupted
As a fleet manager I want vehicle history kept for trend analysis so that slow degradation is visible
As a platform engineer I want a reproducible 100K-vehicle dataset so that every benchmark is repeatable
As a platform engineer I want malformed identifiers rejected so that bad OEM data never reaches analytics
As a DPO I want an immutable record of data access so that accountability can be demonstrated
As a platform engineer I want realistic 100K-vehicle telemetry in three OEM formats so that the pipeline is tested against real-world variety and scale
As a data scientist I want known failure onset and failure times so that predictions can be evaluated honestly

Feature: Delivery anomaly injection (duplicates / out-of-order / malformed / missing)
User Story: As a platform engineer I want realistic bad data so that validation, dedup and DLQ are proven

Feature: Multi-OEM normalisation to a canonical event
User Story: As a platform engineer I want every OEM format mapped to one schema so that downstream logic is written once
As a platform engineer I want invalid payloads quarantined with a reason so that bad data never reaches analytics and can be replayed

Feature: Exact duplicate suppression with out-of-order tolerance
User Story: As a fleet manager I want each event counted once so that alerts and costs are not double counted
As a fleet manager I want to know within seconds when a vehicle overheats or breaks down so that I can act before damage spreads
As a fleet manager I want warnings days before a breakdown so that repairs can be planned

Feature: Tyre leak rate and time-to-critical estimate
User Story: As a fleet manager I want to know how long a leaking tyre can keep running so that I can schedule the fix
As a data scientist I want to score detection against ground truth so that every change to rules or models is measured
